lines.quote: The phased-array work I want to highlight specifically is the transducer array beamforming module I developed for Sinikaari’s experimental PA-OCT prototype in 2020.

That system used a 64-element linear array of piezoelectric transducers for photoacoustic imaging, and I designed the full digital beamforming pipeline: delay-and-sum processing with Hanning apodisation, element-level phase calibration, cable-length compensation, and sidelobe management across the imaging aperture.

Implement and optimise embedded DSP algorithms in C++ for Sinikaari’s optical coherence tomography signal processing hardware, including real-time spectral reconstruction and dispersion compensation running on Xilinx Zynq SoC platforms

Wrote the production Python data pipeline for automated manufacturing QC of the NX-3, processing raw interferometric data through spectral calibration, k-space resampling, and SNR verification — approximately 8,000 lines, deployed on the Oulu factory floor and in daily use

Performed RF characterisation of the NX-3 photodetector and transimpedance amplifier chain, measuring frequency response, S21 gain flatness, and noise spectral density using a Keysight ENA network analyser and custom optical/RF test fixtures
